purpose: Specify external data and documentation required to move a research route from not-testable to protocol-ready. No request has been sent and no acquisition is authorized by this document.

requirements.title: Five-ETF point-in-time total-return, event and paper-implementation evidence
required_fields: date-aligned market-price, NAV/IOPV where applicable, distribution, tax, split, conversion, suspension, code/name and other fund-event treatment with adjustment conventions
source availability timestamps, revisions, field definitions and lawful internal-research retention rights for every historical observation
current legal document and temporary-announcement review, market state, bid/ask/depth, lot/tick, fee/tax, settlement and explicit no-fill/partial-fill fields for each forward paper cycle
periods: every C34 historical observation date and every future monthly paper cycle
preferred_sources: rights-cleared exchange/manager/custodian historical delivery with primary-document reconciliation
dated venue and broker operational documentation without personal account records
requirements.current_public_status: C31/C36 provide dated product facts and C34 retains retrospective market-price rows, but no complete point-in-time total-return/event ledger or date-specific implementation record is retained.
requirements.completion_test: An independent reviewer can reproduce the frozen C34 inputs and distinguish price, NAV/IOPV, distributions, events, fees, taxes, settlement and no-action outcomes. Completion does not override C34's existing limited proxy-screen failure.

requirements.title: Point-in-time SSE public-company-bond master and historical market records
required_fields: daily as-of security master with listing, termination, redemption, code mapping, product classification and trading/suitability state
historic trades, price, volume, turnover, no-trade and trading-status observations
field definitions, units, timestamps, revision policy and coverage exceptions
periods: every candidate research date across the proposed test history
preferred_sources: SSE Info authorized historical-data delivery under written internal-research rights
requirements.current_public_status: Public SSE Info pages and interface documentation describe possible product and field concepts, but no licensed extract, data dictionary or coverage test is retained.
requirements.completion_test: A licensed sample and data dictionary demonstrate complete as-of membership and documented market-field coverage before a broad historical extract is used.

requirements.title: Company-bond full-price, cash-flow and credit-event ledger
required_fields: full price, accrued-interest convention, valuation date and revision treatment
prospectus terms, coupon schedule, payment confirmations, redemption and option events
external-rating history, trustee notices, default, delinquency, restructuring and other material-credit events
issuer-group mapping and source timestamps
periods: every candidate bond and date in the proposed test history
preferred_sources: ChinaBond or Shanghai Clearing licensed historical valuation delivery
licensed reference/event data reconciled to issuer and exchange disclosures
requirements.current_public_status: ChinaBond public pages display field concepts and methodology but do not establish an acquired security-level historical event ledger or use right.
requirements.completion_test: A retained, versioned ledger reconciles a documented sample against dated primary disclosures without filling missing events by assumption.

requirements.title: Dated generic broker implementation documentation
required_fields: per-bond or product-class ordinary-investor permission process and status treatment
minimum trading unit, fees, taxes, settlement, quote, no-fill and partial-fill treatment
document effective date and exclusions
periods: each proposed test and forward-observation date
preferred_sources: dated broker public documentation or written generic operational confirmation without personal account records
requirements.current_public_status: Venue rules establish only general differentiated mechanisms and suitability boundaries.
requirements.completion_test: The documented implementation rules can be applied consistently without inferring an individual's permission or retaining sensitive personal records.

requirements.title: Point-in-time domestic public-REIT universe and total-return ledger
required_fields: as-of universe with listing, termination, expansion, corporate action and trading-status history
price, NAV, distribution, record-date, cash-credit, tax and adjustment conventions
source availability timestamps and revision policy
periods: every candidate research date across the proposed test history
preferred_sources: SSE/SZSE authorized historical-market/reference/announcement data or licensed normalized historical data with primary-disclosure reconciliation
requirements.current_public_status: A nonselective source probe has daily price and distribution rows but an empty captured NAV endpoint and no auditable total-return ledger.
requirements.completion_test: The complete market universe and total-return treatment can be independently reconstructed without mixing price, NAV and cash distribution.

requirements.title: Dated public-REIT implementation and eligibility evidence
required_fields: fund-level and investor-level dated fee and tax treatment
bid/ask, depth, execution, no-fill, partial-fill, suspension and settlement evidence
non-sensitive broker/venue eligibility and risk-disclosure path documentation
periods: each proposed test and forward-observation date
preferred_sources: SSE and manager disclosures plus dated broker operational documentation
requirements.current_public_status: Current rules establish general mechanics but do not prove historic fill quality, costs or a specific person's permission.
requirements.completion_test: All fields are documented without using closing price or volume as a proxy for actual executable outcomes.

requirements.title: Point-in-time public open-ended-fund universe, share-class return/event and operability records
required_fields: daily as-of fund and share-class universe including inception, closure, merger, code/name and status history
non-money-market NAV/accumulated NAV or money-market income, distribution, split, conversion, liquidation, disclosure and availability timestamps
effective-dated fund/channel fee schedules, subscription/redemption/holding-period, cutoff, confirmation, payment, limit and suspension status
field definitions, revision policy, source version, export/API and internal-research retention rights
periods: every candidate research date across the proposed test history
preferred_sources: licensed fund master and historical-data delivery with written internal-research rights
manager/custodian/CSRC primary-disclosure sample reconciliation
requirements.current_public_status: Regulatory disclosure obligations and public locators exist, but no historic full-universe, share-class event/fee/status data delivery or reproducible right is retained.
requirements.completion_test: C23-GATE-1 receives a rights-cleared sample including inactive funds, data dictionaries and primary-source reconciliation, then an independent reviewer can reproduce the accepted inputs.

requirements.title: Declared-scope direct-equity universe, market/event and availability data
required_fields: point-in-time security master for every declared market/board, including listings, terminations, suspensions, warning status, code/name changes and inactive securities
raw prices, volume, no-trade/status, corporate actions, adjustment factors/algorithm, filing first-publication and availability timestamps, revisions and missing-data rules
periods: every candidate research date across the proposed test history and every future included stock
preferred_sources: SSE/SZSE authorized historical data plus primary disclosures
BSE historical delivery if the declared scope includes BSE
contractually verified normalized provider with primary-document reconciliation
requirements.current_public_status: Conditional market-data and public-disclosure paths exist. C40-C42 now retain limited issuer/exchange files for three non-admitted subjects, but no rights-cleared point-in-time declared-scope dataset, BSE historic coverage for a BSE-including scope, complete event chain or G0-G9-complete per-stock diligence package is retained.
requirements.completion_test: A retained and independently reproducible declared-scope data package passes source, event and availability checks before any paper protocol is frozen.

requirements.title: Date-versioned direct-equity cost/execution records and per-stock institutional diligence
required_fields: dated trading, settlement, clearing-fee, tax, commission and paper-execution assumptions
full equity-research evidence, valuation, risk, governance, industry-chain and tradability package for every future included stock
independent-review record, source hashes and exceptions for every included stock
periods: every candidate research date and every future included stock
preferred_sources: exchange/clearing/tax archives and public broker tariff history
case-scoped full equity-research source packs and independent review artifacts
requirements.current_public_status: Current rules and fee documents do not provide complete historic implementation records. C40-C42 are partial non-admitted dossiers, not complete per-stock valuation, liquidity, total-return, execution or independent-review packages.
requirements.completion_test: An independent reviewer can rebuild declared costs and confirm that every future included stock passed full institutional equity-research diligence before the paper protocol is frozen.

requirements.title: New domestic ETF hypothesis: rights-cleared investor-total-return/event and execution dataset
required_fields: date-specific ETF/share-class universe with listing, termination, merger, suspension, status and survivorship history
unambiguous market-price/NAV/accumulated-NAV/total-return/net-return convention, complete distributions/splits/conversions/fee/term events and effective dates
published_at, available_at, revision history, source version, raw object hash, parser version and written retention/replay/derived-analysis/independent-review rights
decision-time bid/ask or a conservative predeclared fill/no-fill convention, depth, limits, status, fees, taxes and settlement treatment
periods: every universe, event and observation date in a prospective frozen ETF hypothesis
preferred_sources: written-rights exchange/manager/custodian historical delivery with primary-document reconciliation
official index-provider files only as separately labelled benchmark inputs
requirements.current_public_status: C37 records official public routes and retained limited observations, but none closes every historical investor-total-return/event/execution/right gate.
requirements.completion_test: An independent reviewer can replay the point-in-time universe, return/event ledger, cost/execution treatment and data provenance without treating OHLCV, NAV or an index benchmark as an ETF investor return.

requirements.title: C39 audited cash-flow realization cohort: locked data, execution and forward-observation package
required_fields: rights-cleared point-in-time universe including inactive, renamed, suspended, risk-warning and delisted non-financial common shares across SSE/SZSE/BSE
audited filings and first-public/available-at records, industry map, corporate-action/event ledger, accounting-restatement chain and frozen extraction dictionary for every eligibility input
decision-time displayed side quotes/depth, limits, status, no-fill, fee/tax/settlement rules and source versions for each formation and outcome observation
immutable code/data manifest, independent reconstruction log, all P1-P4 integrity metrics and two full annual-report cycles of F1 forward observations
periods: all preregistered historical formation/outcome dates and every F1 observation through the two-cycle forward requirement
preferred_sources: contractually permitted exchange/reference/filing delivery with primary-document reconciliation
dated authoritative fee/tax/settlement records and an independently retained evidence archive
requirements.current_public_status: C39 is preregistered only. C40-C42 partial issuer archives do not supply C39's universal point-in-time cohort, total-return, execution or forward-record requirements.
requirements.completion_test: Before any calculation, an independent reviewer accepts every C39 field and provenance gate; after that, the frozen P1-P4 and F1 sequence can run without product substitution, retuning or a portfolio-action inference.

requirements.title: Actual-contract calendar-pair execution, lifecycle and rights package
required_fields: point-in-time actual-contract master, final-trading-day, delivery-state, offset eligibility, dynamic margin, position-limit and risk-control records for both legs
decision-time two-sided quotes, depth, limits, no-fill/partial-fill, legging treatment, fees, taxes, settlement, collateral and broker-product eligibility records
published-at, available-at, revision history, source version, raw-object hash and written retention/replay/derived-analysis/independent-review rights
a preregistered pair-continuity, stop, roll and reconciliation specification that does not amend C46
periods: every formation, holding, roll, delivery-boundary and forward-observation date of a newly frozen route
preferred_sources: contractually permitted exchange/reference/broker operational delivery reconciled to official contract and risk-control notices
independently retained primary source archive
requirements.current_public_status: C45/C46/C47 establish only a limited historical source-field audit and a closed no-result route. They do not create a data contract or reopen C46.
requirements.completion_test: An independent reviewer can verify both legs' eligible state, executable/no-fill treatment, cost and source timing before a new economically distinct protocol is frozen.

requirements.route: any new formal domestic historical strategy research
requirements.title: Written-rights point-in-time, total-return, availability/revision and execution data acceptance package
required_fields: rights-cleared point-in-time investable universe including inactive, renamed, suspended, risk-warning and delisted instruments
complete corporate-action, distribution, rights, merger, spin-off, delisting, restatement and total-return ledger
published-at, available-at, revision/version, raw-object hash, field dictionary and written retention/replay/derived-analysis/independent-review rights
decision-time quote/depth/status/limit/no-fill, cost, tax and settlement records or a conservatively accepted no-fill protocol
periods: every historical decision, outcome, event and forward-observation date in a new route
preferred_sources: user-authorized licensed data delivery with written internal-research rights
independent primary-document reconciliation archive
requirements.current_public_status: C48 finds that the present public-observation environment does not jointly meet these field, timing, rights and execution requirements.
requirements.completion_test: A source-governance reviewer accepts the full data contract before any new protocol is frozen; the delivery must not be inferred from public OHLCV or archive hashes.

boundary: This request specification does not select a product, imply a data purchase, close a research blocker or authorize external action.
